body:
Operator authorized full four-PR implementation unattended, with advisor coordination for questions/review. Starting isolated STORY-1843 PR1; will use Refs STORY-1843 until PR4 and independent attested reviews (STRICT for PR2/4). Mail checks about every 15 minutes while a reply is pending.

PR1 boundary question: C1 asks snapshot audience, private receipts and explicit --queue-for-role assignment; C2 says no schema change. Proposed PR1 uses existing message/receipt formats plus local runtime audience/queue sidecars (no Message schema change), with canonical sidecar persistence needed for sync safety. Alternative: PR1 only refuses zero readers (no --queue-for-role until PR2), and lists current readers; PR2 adds persisted audience/queue binding and private receipts together. Recommend the alternative if sidecars would defeat the small-PR objective. Please rule on this slice boundary before I implement queue/receipt changes. Shared resolver and unknown/dead refusal work can proceed independently.
subject: STORY-1843 implementation start; PR1 queue/receipt boundary
